column1: # Commits on main authored as `Hermes Agent <agent@hermes.local>` that were Brooklyn Nicholson's
# (GitHub: OutThisLife) agent-assisted work. A repo-local git identity on her machine stamped them
# with an address no GitHub account can verify, so GitHub credited them to nobody. main can't be
# rewritten, so each row below has a matching attribution commit, authored by her at the original
# date, that names the original commit.

column3: fix(desktop): preserve implicit default local route
fix(desktop): adopt a published session token on the post-update relaunch
fix(desktop): ignore auto-repeat and post-focus Ctrl+W/Ctrl+R
fix(desktop): stop an entered project refetching on every tree refresh (#77591)
fix(desktop): list a compressed project chat once (#77591)
fix(desktop): keep pip downloads and cache files out of Artifacts
fix(desktop): decide image bytes vs path from the session owner's own backend
fix(desktop): log what ssh did when an SSH connect fails
refactor(desktop): move project scope into a dependency-light store module
fix(desktop): leave the entered project when switching profile or backend
fix(desktop): tear down a HUD whose renderer dies before first paint (#108230)
